### clean object

```{r}
# 1. Extract the raw counts and metadata
raw_counts <- GetAssayData(data, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts")
metadata <- data@meta.data

# 2. Create a new Seurat object
# This automatically removes all DimReducs, Graphs, and extra Assays
clean_seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = raw_counts, 
                                   meta.data = metadata)
```

```{r}
VlnPlot(clean_seurat, 
        features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt", "percent.ribo"),
        ncol = 4, 
        pt.size = 0.5,
        alpha = 0.01)
```

```{r}
clean_nFeature <- VlnPlot(clean_seurat, 
        features = c("nFeature_RNA"), 
        ncol = 1, pt.size = 0.5, alpha = 0.05)

clean_mt <- VlnPlot(clean_seurat, features = c("percent.mt"), ncol=1, pt.size = 0.5, alpha = 0.05)

```

```{r}
print(clean_mt)
```

### Count matrix

```{r}
# Load the data
# header = TRUE assumes the first row contains cell names
# sep = "\t" specifies it is a tab-separated file
raw_counts <- fread("/home/projects/exam_2026_22102/group2/test_pull/B005-A-201_atac_fragments.tsv.gz", header = TRUE)

# Convert to a data frame so we can set row names
# Often, the first column contains gene names
raw_counts <- as.data.frame(raw_counts)
rownames(raw_counts) <- raw_counts[[1]]
raw_counts <- raw_counts[, -1] # Remove the original gene name column
```

```{r}
# Convert the dense data frame to a sparse matrix
sparse_counts <- as.sparse(as.matrix(raw_counts))
```

## 01. The intestine dataset

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(Seurat)
  library(Signac)
  library(Matrix)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tidyverse)
})
```

### Testing HCA Download

```{r}
proj_prefix <- "B011-A-002"
path_to_B011 <- str_c("/home/projects/exam_2026_22102/group2/intestine_data/", proj_prefix,"/")
atac_annotation_bed <- "/home/projects/exam_2026_22102/group2/stromal_peaks.bed.gz"

# 1. Load the sparse matrix
counts <- ReadMtx(
  mtx = str_c(path_to_B011, proj_prefix, "_matrix.mtx.gz"), 
  features = str_c(path_to_B011, proj_prefix, "_features.tsv.gz"), 
  cells = str_c(path_to_B011, proj_prefix, "_barcodes.tsv.gz") 
)

# 2. Create the Seurat Object
seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts, project = proj_prefix)
```

```{r}
head(seurat_obj)
```

### Attach ATAC data

```{r}
# Path to your fragments file
frag_path <- str_c(path_to_B011, "B011-A-002_atac_fragments.tsv.gz.tbi")

# 1. Create a Fragment object
# 'cells' should match the barcodes already in your Seurat object
frags <- CreateFragmentObject(
  path = frag_path,
  cells = colnames(seurat_obj)
)

# 2. Add the fragments to the ATAC assay
# This assumes your ATAC assay is named "ATAC"
Fragments(seurat_obj[["ATAC"]]) <- frags
```

## 02. The spatial dataset

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(Seurat)
library(Signac)
library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)


path_to_dir <- "/home/projects/exam_2026_22102/group2/data_v2/"

# 1. LOAD SPATIAL DATA (Primary Assay)
# The .h5 file from the HCA contains the gene expression matrix.
# Since this is spatial data, we set the assay to "Spatial".
spatial_counts <- Read10X_h5(str_c(path_to_dir, "spatial_10X0018_raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5"))

# Create the Seurat object
heart_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = spatial_counts,
  assay = "Spatial",
  project = "Heart_MI_Spatial"
)
```

#### ATAC data

```{r}
# 2. INCORPORATE ATAC DATA (Secondary Assay)
# Load the ATAC peak counts (TSV from HCA)
atac_raw <- read.table(gzfile(str_c(path_to_dir, "10X_ATAC_CK354.tsv.gz")), header = TRUE, row.names = 1)
atac_sparse <- as.sparse(as.matrix(atac_raw))
```

```{r}
# Check for barcode overlap
# Spatial and ATAC barcodes must match exactly. 
# Sometimes spatial barcodes have a suffix (like "-1"); adjust if needed.
common_cells <- intersect(colnames(heart_obj), colnames(atac_sparse))
if(length(common_cells) == 0) {
  stop("No overlapping barcodes found between Spatial and ATAC data. Check barcode suffixes.")
}

# Create Chromatin Assay (Signac)
# Using hg38 as specified in the myocardial infarction project metadata
atac_assay <- CreateChromatinAssay(
  counts = atac_sparse[, common_cells],
  sep = c(":", "-"),
  genome = "hg38"
)

# Add to the existing spatial object
#heart_obj <- subset(heart_obj, cells = common_cells)
#heart_obj[["ATAC"]] <- atac_assay
```
